title: LLA to ECEF Position
text: Calculate Earth-centered Earth-fixed (ECEF) position from geodetic latitude, longitude, and altitude above planetary ellipsoid, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Units}, {Planet model}, {Flattening} and {Equatorial radius of planet} sets the radius of planet at equator. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Equatorial radius of planet
params.values: Radius of planet at equator 6378137 (default) | scalar
